The Rambai Audit Institute reopened the city school meal contract this month and reported a Rp6.4 billion reduction in the annual cost against the 2030 baseline. The saving comes from three changes: refrigerated delivery moves from nightly runs to twice weekly, produce is ordered through a single central supplier instead of the twelve district lots used until December, and preparation shifts one hour earlier so kitchens open before the first delivery window.
